resources.title: You'll NEVER Build Tarkov Weapons The Same Way Again...
resources.creator: Gigabeef
resources.noteEs: Gigabeef analiza cambios meta en cómo armar weapons post-1.0: prioridades de mod, balance de ergonomía vs recoil y por qué algunas builds que eran S-tier dejaron de serlo.
resources.noteEn: Gigabeef analyzes post-1.0 meta changes in how to build weapons: mod priorities, ergo-vs-recoil balance, and why some S-tier builds aren't anymore.

resources.title: Is taking the AA-12 Shotgun to Icebreaker a good idea - Escape From Tarkov
resources.creator: LVNDMARK
resources.noteEs: Test empírico del AA-12 (shotgun automática) como pick para el contenido Icebreaker. LVNDMARK valida si la teoría funciona en práctica con dispersión, daño por slot y rituales de munición.
resources.noteEn: Empirical test of the AA-12 (automatic shotgun) as a pick for Icebreaker content. LVNDMARK validates whether theory works in practice with spread, damage per slot, and ammo handling.

resources.title: The PKM works SURPRISINGLY WELL on Icebreaker - Escape From Tarkov
resources.creator: LVNDMARK
resources.noteEs: Sorpresa de meta: la PKM (light machine gun pesada) resulta efectiva en el escenario Icebreaker. Análisis de por qué un loadout antes considerado meme se vuelve viable según el mapa.
resources.noteEn: Meta surprise: the PKM (heavy LMG) turns out effective in the Icebreaker scenario. Analysis of why a previously meme loadout becomes viable depending on the map.

resources.title: How Much MONEY Can I Make in 1 RAID on ICEBREAKER? - Escape From Tarkov
resources.creator: LVNDMARK
resources.noteEs: Análisis económico: cuánto rouble se puede sacar de una raid efectiva en el escenario Icebreaker. Útil para calibrar expectativas y decidir si el mapa vale el riesgo según tu nivel.
resources.noteEn: Economic analysis: how many roubles can be earned from an effective raid in the Icebreaker scenario. Useful to calibrate expectations and decide if the map is worth the risk at your level.

resources.title: We Need To Talk About Pay To Win Again In Tarkov...
resources.creator: Gigabeef
resources.noteEs: Análisis crítico del modelo pay-to-win de Tarkov post-1.0, particularmente con las ediciones premium y stash size. Lectura honesta del debate de monetización en la comunidad.
resources.noteEn: Critical analysis of Tarkov's post-1.0 pay-to-win model, particularly with premium editions and stash size. Honest read on the community's monetization debate.
